scope: Compare nine explicit flat MaxPMProfile LIMIT periods with three direct LIMIT rows using IQTY3/IINT12, for one 12-hour 0-to-1-to-2 capacity pattern repeated three times. The v1.0.0 and v1.0.1 subprofile forms remain excluded diagnostics. Accept only native physical PM and event/report parity for this fixed SIMLOX 2017 source pair.

manual.rule: MaxPMProfile supports end and subprofiles; a referenced subprofile may repeat IQTY times at IINT spacing. Explicit LIMIT periods must not overlap; profile MAXPM overrides Unit.MAXPM.

frozen_source_delta: Derive both arms from accepted D13.var03 rise input: seed1, two aircraft, one CAL24 PM, three scheduled h8/h20/h32 missions, scalar Unit.MAXPM0 and 36-hour horizon unchanged.
Flat CAP-FLAT has three adjacent LIMIT rows per 12-hour cycle: capacity0 for 0.25h, capacity1 for the next 0.5h, and capacity2 for the remaining 11.25h. Nine rows cover h0-36.

The comparison arm named nested in filenames instead uses CAP-REPEAT with three direct LIMIT rows at h0, h0.25, and h0.75, each carrying IQTY3/IINT12. Only description, Unit.MAXPMP and MaxPMProfile rows differ between arms. This tests direct LIMIT repetition, not a subprofile hierarchy.
acceptance_hypotheses: Both sources import and roundtrip exact authored populated cells, with zero converter errors and usable SXOs. Direct LIMIT repetition parameters survive the roundtrip. Classify all warnings without interpreting exit code zero as success.

The flat and repeated event logs and all non-description report cells match. In the third cycle, both create CAL24 tasks at h24 and physically start aircraft0 at h24.25 and aircraft1 at h24.75, with half-hour overlap.
All three missions succeed, 72 System/Stock half-hour bins reconcile, both PM tasks complete, and both aircraft are ready at h36.
gate: Publish only if flat/repeated logs and non-description report cells match, native events prove the h24 profile effect, conversion and authored roundtrip pass, 22 raw files are sealed, and independent read-only replay agrees. Otherwise retain immutable diagnostic and revise a new version. Do not infer hidden counters or a general hierarchy law.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID 13340/session 1 identity, immutable run path, 60-second targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One seed, two aircraft, one PM and three direct LIMIT repetitions; no subprofile hierarchy claim, overlapping-limit errors, other cycle lengths, GUI or cross-engine claim.
